Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The study contains two distinct proteomics workflows: 1) A TAP-MS approach for protein-protein interactions (DDA, LFQ) and 2) A TMT-labeled phosphoproteomics approach using TiO2 enrichment. Both are captured in the routing hints.

organism: Proteins were identified using Mascot (Matrix Sciences) to search the Homo sapiens UniProtKB database.
cell_lines: SFB-tagged TLK1, SFB-TLK1 1–240, SFB-TLK1 D607A, SFB-TLK1 133–208, SFB-TLK1 13-208 Y149A F150A or SFB-TLK2 were transfected into HEK293T cells.
scope: Tandem affinity purification (TAP) was carried out

The protein complexes were eluted with 2 mg/ml biotin at 4°C for 1 h. The eluents were then incubated with S-protein agarose (EMD Millipore, 69704-3) overnight at 4°C, washed three times with NETN buffer, and eluted in 1× Laemmli buffer.
Protein complexes obtained from TAP were processed by in-gel trypsin digestion and analyzed by tandem mass spectrometry.
